question: What prompted changes in the State Co-operative Societies Acts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poor quality of functioning**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The changes in the State Co-operative Societies Acts were prompted by the **poor quality of functioning** of several co-operative societies.
 
• Many co-operative societies faced issues like **inefficiency, mismanagement, and lack of accountability**, which necessitated reforms in their governance structures.
 
• The poor performance of co-operative societies led to **inadequate service delivery** to their members and stakeholders.
 
• To address these challenges, the State Co-operative Societies Acts were modified to introduce measures such as **better financial monitoring, improved governance, and stricter audit processes**.
 
• These reforms aimed to **restore trust and improve the operational efficiency** of co-operative societies across the states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Co-operative Societies:**

 
 
• Co-operative societies are organizations formed by individuals with a common interest, primarily to meet their economic, social, and cultural needs.
 
• They are governed by the **Co-operative Societies Act, 1912**, and respective State Acts.
 
• Their core principles include **voluntary membership, democratic decision-making, and equitable distribution of benefits**.
 
 
 
• **Common Issues in Co-operative Societies:**
 
 
• Lack of professionalism and skilled management often results in **inefficient operations**.
 
• Instances of corruption and political interference have led to **misuse of resources**.
 
• Inadequate financial oversight and poor audit mechanisms result in **fraudulent practices**.
 
 
 
• **Reforms in Co-operative Sector:**
 
 
• Efforts like the **97th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2011**, sought to improve transparency and democratic governance in co-operatives.
 
• Provisions were added to ensure **regular elections, proper audits, and member empowerment**.
 
• State-level reforms often focus on **reducing political interference** and improving operational efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Role of NABARD:**
 
 
• The **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)** provides financial and technical support to co-operative institutions.
 
• It also works on **capacity building and institutional strengthening** of co-operatives.
